reviews.text: The last time I took my dog ​​for a bath and sanitary trim, they couldn't complete the trim because they said the dog wouldn't let them touch his paws, and yet I was still charged the full price. Okay, fine, I accepted it, paid, and didn't complain. Now I went to schedule a full bath and scissor trim, but first I asked if they could do it completely because last time I paid the full price without getting the full service. The person in charge of the establishment said it wouldn't be possible, saying my dog ​​is aggressive, hahaha. No, he's not aggressive, but you need patience to groom and bathe him; he's a small Poodle/Lhasa mix and extremely timid. And she said that last time they charged the full price because they tried and the dog wouldn't let them, hahaha. The correct thing would be not to charge or to charge only part of the price. If they don't have qualified professionals to provide the service and just say "unfortunately, we won't be able to" and move on, I would never question or complain. Now, saying they charged the full price because they tried and couldn't, and then blaming the dog, is too much for me. Pet Pew, understand there are dozens of pet shops in downtown São Paulo, and I always change places to try them out and I've never had this kind of problem. I was only going to you because it was a recommendation, and the person who recommended you also stopped going because of scheduling conflicts. I'm going to take my dog ​​to be groomed by PROFESSIONALS who know how to handle dogs. 🤷
